================================================================================
  CURRENT ARCHITECTURE DOCUMENTATION - FRD15EU_DS4 PROJECT
================================================================================

Date: March 18, 2026
Project: FRD15EU DS4 Embedded Firmware
Build System: Keil uVision 4 (legacy) → CMake migration in progress
MCU Target: NXP LPC1766 (ARM Cortex-M3)
Total Source Files: ~2,322 files
Total Libraries: ~195 library components

This document describes the CURRENT state of the architecture after the initial
migration to the layered structure within `.cmake_migration/code/src/SDK/`.

================================================================================
ARCHITECTURAL OVERVIEW
================================================================================

The codebase follows a three-layer OSI-like architecture with clear separation
of concerns:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  APP (Application Layer)                                                 │
│  High-level application logic, features, services, and vehicle control  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    ↕
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer)                                       │
│  Hardware abstraction, communication protocols, OS services             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    ↕
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  BSP (Board Support Package)                                            │
│  Low-level hardware drivers, peripherals, MCU-specific code             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

ADDITIONAL LAYERS:
- **ENTRY**: Application entry points (main functions, task initialization)
- **INC**: Configuration headers and build-time configuration files
- **UNUSED**: Deprecated/legacy libraries retained for reference


================================================================================
DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
================================================================================

.cmake_migration/code/src/SDK/
├── APP/                          # Application Layer (81 libraries)
│   ├── features/                 # Product features (DEI, Falcon, NGMM)
│   ├── framework/                # System framework and status management
│   ├── services/                 # Core services (queues, events, sensors, etc.)
│   ├── utilities/                # Utility libraries (CRC, bitfield, etc.)
│   └── vehicle/                  # Vehicle-specific logic
│       ├── diagnostics/          # VIN, OBD-CAN diagnostics
│       ├── programming/          # Device programming and configuration
│       └── security/             # DST, key management, encryption
│
├── BSP/                          # Board Support Package (37 libraries)
│   ├── bootloader/               # Bootloader and memory scatter files
│   ├── mcu/                      # MCU-specific implementations
│   │   ├── device/               # Device identification
│   │   └── lpc1700/              # LPC1700-specific drivers
│   └── peripherals/              # Peripheral drivers
│       ├── analog/               # ADC, DAC
│       ├── can/                  # CAN bus driver
│       ├── gpio/                 # GPIO control
│       ├── interrupts/           # Interrupt handlers (FIQ, IRQ, VIC)
│       ├── serial/               # UART/SIO/HOBP bus drivers
│       ├── timers/               # RTC, TMR, VRTC
│       └── watchdog/             # Watchdog timer
│
├── HAL/                          # Hardware Abstraction Layer (24 libraries)
│   ├── communication/            # Communication protocols
│   │   ├── can/                  # CAN protocol stack
│   │   ├── d2d/                  # Device-to-Device protocol
│   │   ├── hobp/                 # Honda OBD Protocol
│   │   └── rf/                   # RF communication (Keeloq, RFTD)
│   ├── io/                       # I/O abstraction (LED, input/output drivers)
│   ├── os/                       # OS services
│   │   └── scheduler/            # Task scheduler, reset handler
│   ├── power/                    # Power management
│   │   └── wake/                 # Wake-up and low-power mode handling
│   ├── security/                 # Security services
│   │   └── (AES128, AID/DHP)    # Encryption and authentication
│   └── storage/                  # Storage abstraction
│       └── nvfs/                 # Non-volatile file system
│
├── ENTRY/                        # Entry Points (2 libraries)
│   ├── lib.main_1700/            # Main application entry
│   └── lib.ngmm_task_main/       # NGMM task initialization
│
├── INC/                          # Include/Configuration Files (9 collections)
│   ├── cmall/                    # CMall-specific configuration headers
│   │   ├── core/                 # Core config (version, D2D, GPIO, dummy)
│   │   └── inc.config_fw/        # Firmware configuration (GPIO, features)
│
└── UNUSED/                       # Deprecated/Legacy (42 libraries)
    ├── APP/                      # Unused application libraries
    ├── BSP/                      # Unused BSP libraries (flash, old GPIO)
    ├── HAL/                      # Unused HAL libraries (old OS, wake, NVFS)
    └── INC/                      # Unused configuration headers

⚠️  NOTE: Vehicle-Specific Customization Libraries
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
According to proposed_architecture.txt, the following THREE libraries must
be customized for each vehicle model:

1. com.lib.detect/   - Vehicle detection (CAN, IGN, VIN identification)
2. com.lib.func/     - Vehicle control functions (lock, unlock, arm)
3. com.lib.sense/    - Vehicle sensor reading (doors, ignition, etc.)

⚠️  MISSING FROM CURRENT STRUCTURE:
These three libraries are NOT present in the current SDK structure.
They may be:
- Still in the original cmall/common folders (migration incomplete)
- Split across multiple existing libraries
- Pending migration

ACTION REQUIRED: Locate and migrate these vehicle-specific libraries.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

┌─ ENTRY/ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Application entry points and main functions                               │

================================================================================
LAYER DEPENDENCY RELATIONSHIPS
================================================================================

The architecture enforces clear dependency rules:

    APP Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: HAL, BSP (through HAL)
      └─ Never depends on: ENTRY, INC (includes headers only)
      
    HAL Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: BSP
      └─ Never depends on: APP, ENTRY
      
    BSP Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: (nothing - lowest layer)
      └─ Never depends on: HAL, APP, ENTRY
      
    ENTRY Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: APP, HAL, BSP (orchestrates everything)
      └─ Never provides: reusable APIs (only entry points)
      
    INC Layer
      │
      ├─ Provides: Configuration headers (compile-time constants)
      ├─ Included by: All layers
      └─ Never contains: Executable code


================================================================================
HONDA OBD PROTOCOL (HOBP) INTEGRATION
================================================================================

The HOBP libraries provide Honda vehicle immobilizer bypass functionality:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      HOBP ARCHITECTURAL STACK                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  HAL/communication/hobp/com.ext.hobp_type6/                                 │
│  ├── hobp.h                      - Public API                               │
│  ├── hobp_init.c                 - Initialization and NVFS setup            │
│  ├── hobp_is_prog.c              - Programming mode detection               │
│  ├── hobp_rx/tx.c                - Protocol message handling                │
│  ├── hobp_csum.c                 - Checksum calculation                     │
│  └── hobp_gwr.c                  - GWR (Gateway) functions                  │
│                                                                             │
│  Depends on:                                                                │
│  ├── BSP/peripherals/serial/com.ext.hobp_bus/ (low-level bus driver)       │
│  ├── HAL/storage/nvfs/ (ISK and challenge/response storage)                │
│  └── APP/services/queues/ (message queuing)                                 │
│                                                                             │
│  ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ │
│                                                                             │
│  BSP/peripherals/serial/com.ext.hobp_bus/                                   │
│  ├── hobp_bus.h                  - Bus driver API                           │
│  ├── hobp_bus_init.c             - Bus initialization                       │
│  ├── hobp_bus_rx/tx.c            - ISO K-Line Rx/Tx (10400 baud)           │
│  ├── hobp_bus_fiq_service.c      - FIQ interrupt handler (timing critical) │
│  └── hobp_bus_set_baudrate.c     - Baudrate configuration                   │
│                                                                             │
│  Depends on:                                                                │
│  ├── BSP/peripherals/gpio/ (ISO1/ISO2 line control)                         │
│  ├── BSP/peripherals/interrupts/ (FIQ/IRQ handlers)                         │
│  └── BSP/peripherals/timers/ (bit timing)                                   │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Key Features:
- ISO K-Line communication at 10400 baud (Honda-specific timing)
- Type 6 challenge-response authentication protocol
- ISK (Immobilizer Secret Key) storage in NVFS
- Programming mode and Pass-Thru Support (PTS)
- Configurable for ISO1 or ISO2 physical lines via config_hobp_bus.h

Usage:
- Initialize with hobp_init() and hobp_bus_init()
- Check programming mode: hobp_is_prog()
- Transmit: hobp_bus_tx()
- Register receive queue: hobp_bus_reg()
- Configuration: INC/common/config_hobp.h and config_hobp_bus.h


================================================================================
KEY ARCHITECTURAL PATTERNS
================================================================================

1. **Library Naming Convention:**
   - Core libraries: `lib.<name>`
   - Common/shared: `com.lib.<name>` or `com.ext.lib.<name>`
   - Hardware-specific: `lib.<name>_<mcu>` (e.g., `lib.main_1700`)
   - Configuration: `inc.<category>` or `config_<feature>.h`

2. **File Organization:**
   - Each library is a self-contained folder
   - Headers typically named `<library>.h`
   - Implementation split into multiple `.c` files
   - Private headers: `<library>_private.h`

3. **Hardware Abstraction:**
   - BSP provides raw peripheral access
   - HAL wraps BSP in portable APIs
   - APP uses HAL APIs only (no direct BSP access)

4. **Configuration Management:**
   - Project-specific: `INC/cmall/inc.config_fw/`
   - Hardware-specific: `INC/cmall/core/inc.config_1700/`

5. **Service-Oriented Design:**
   - Services provide reusable functionality (queues, events, timing)
   - Features implement product-specific behavior (DEI, Falcon, NGMM)
   - Utilities provide low-level helpers (CRC, bitfield)

6. **Communication Stack Pattern:**
   - Bus drivers in BSP (CAN, SIO, HOBP bus)
   - Protocol layers in HAL (CAN.v, D2D, HOBP, RF)
   - Application integration in APP (vehicle-specific usage)
